Maya (AE): Customer 'Sanctum' needs POC for SAML (Azure AD), SCIM (nested groups), RBAC mapping and pricing: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private. Can we start next week?
Dev (SE): Checklist: DNS tenant pin, SAML metadata exchange, SCIM token, expected user/group counts, CA requirements, and whether they need audit export.
Jordan (Customer): They run strict Conditional Access: MFA + device/compliance. Prefer Private control plane or IP allowlist. Also need SCIM audit logs sent to our SIEM.
Priya (Security): We can stream SCIM/audit logs to customer S3/syslog in Private; Dedicated supports IP allowlist. Hosted needs egress IP exceptions. We'll attach SOC2/ISO evidence and a sample token rotation policy.
Sam (Eng): Nested groups supported via flattening during sync; we can accept bulk CSV for initial import to avoid paging throttles. For 60k users/2.5k groups plan delta every 15m.
Jordan (Customer): Numbers: ~60k users, ~2.5k groups, nested ~300. Peak auths ~7k sessions/day. Legal asks SAML metadata and SCIM rotation policy.
Dev (SE): Pricing ballpark: 3-week POC ~ $5k (shared infra + small Dedicated); 6mo Dedicated estimate depends on tokens/sec and model footprint — will send spreadsheet after throughput numbers.
Maya (AE): Blockers to go-live: DNS TXT verification, AAD app + SAML metadata, SCIM creds, and decision on Dedicated vs Private for CA.
Jordan (Customer): I'll provision AAD app and add DNS TXT by Tue. Also confirm SOC2/ISO docs and SCIM token rotation sample.
Priya (Security): Draft answer for questionnaire re: data residency and logs will be posted. Recommend rotating SCIM tokens quarterly; Private can automate via KMS.
deploy-bot: POC env scheduled 2026-04-08T14:00Z.
Maya (AE): Next steps: Dev to send mapping example and bulk CSV schema; Priya to attach compliance snippets; Jordan to provide metadata. Back here when ready. :thumbsup:
